description: This file defines an abstract base class for CLI commands in a server-side application, including environment setup, process termination handling, and command flags.

classes.name: BaseCommand
classes.description: An abstract class extending oclif's Command, providing common setup, termination, and environment configuration for CLI commands.

methods.name: stopProcess
methods.description: Placeholder for stopping the process, meant to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: onTerminate
methods.description: Returns an async function to handle termination signals, including forced shutdown after 30 seconds.

methods.name: gracefullyExit
methods.description: Exits the process with success code.

methods.name: failExit
methods.description: Exits the process with failure code.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the command, sets up signal handlers, error logging, and environment variables from CLI flags.
